The original for insane 2d gameplay. The 2nd for insane 3d gameplay

I don't have the skills to finish a few of the achievements and so I'm stuck at 92% complete but I can't overstate what an awesome game this is!  Beautiful pixel graphics, awesome unlocking scheme, awesome flavor text, 10/10 ragefest
one of my favorites, constantly changing so i dont get bored. fun and good graphics. text way too small though, adjusting size of text would be really helpful

A really fun game. My friend was right in recommending this to me. 
A single run can take as little as 40 minutes and as long as 4 hours even 8 if one enjoys going through countless small enemies and bosses spawning in a rapid fire sequence and risking of losing mental sanity after one small mistake that costs you everything you put on the line. But anyway. There are some small combinations one can do with the items and the different characters and it's a pleasure playing and figuring out those. If you get too greedy be careful because the game could crash and you could lose everything in that run. There is an item in particular that gives me the most problems with crashes and fps dropping so I often avoid it ([spoiler] Arms Race [/spoiler]). I don't expect a fluid experience with 300+ mobs on the screen anyway.
It's quite a hassle to play in multiplayer though (biggest con) and it has some small visual bugs on MacOS but nothing that hinders the game too much.  It also has some little bugs, like your character getting stuck in platforms, but those happen rarely, that in particular happened to me just once or twice in all my hours. Due to some items (monster records that are important only for the game completion) that drop [u] randomly [/u] when you kill a monster or a boss monster, it's taking me so long to actually finish the game, but I hope you'll have better luck than mine!

It seems like that I wrote more about the cons, but I enjoyed almost every moment of the game. 

kheliaal
